title: Parameter contract prober and adaptive error translator
creator: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: callers continue to encounter opaque and hard-to-action validation errors when invoking tools/functions via the Core API. Root causes include mismatched field shapes (strings vs ints), optional vs required confusion, enum normalization, and nested shorthand forms used by front-end authors. Goals: (1) implement a low-overhead runtime "prober" that aggregates non-sensitive call shapes and frequent validation failure classes; (2) build an adaptive error translator that maps raw validation failures into actionable, localized suggestions and (optionally) best-effort reparations; (3) expose findings to SDKs/Console and emit telemetry to help model-onboarding and schema authoring. Privacy: probe only metadata and non-sensitive, redacted samples; provide customer opt-out and PII detection/stripping. Success metrics: reduce developer-reported ambiguous tool-call bugs by 40% within 6 weeks of pilot; decrease mean time to resolution (MTTR) for schema mismatches by 30%.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime prober collects aggregated call-shapes and top-10 validation error classes without storing PII (redaction tested)
Adaptive translator produces deterministic human-readable hints for the top 20 error patterns (examples included)
SDK surface: when translator available, SDK maps runtime error -> suggestion payload for in-app UX and quick-fix snippets
Opt-in flag and admin setting in Console to enable/disable probing per-organization
Benchmarks: <5% p99 latency increase on hot path and <3% extra CPU for validation pipeline under 95th percentile load
notes: We will implement prober as an asynchronous sampler that runs in the validation path; it must be bounded and backpressure-aware.
Prefer lossy, structured summaries (counts, field type histograms, common enum tokens) over raw payloads.
Adaptive repairs are conservative: only perform automatic coercions for safe, reversible transforms (e.g., numeric string -> int). All other suggestions must be opt-in by SDK.
Telemetry schema documented in internal Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Parameter+Prober
Preliminary perf spike seen in local benchmark when sample rate > 5% — target sample rate default: 0.5% per route.
Coordinate with Privacy and Security for PII classifier integration (PR planned).

Phase 2 (2w): adaptive translator rules engine, hint templates, SDK mapping hooks (JS/py)

Phase 4 (ongoing): expand rule coverage, add ML-based clustering for new patterns, ship telemetry to model-onboarding dashboards
